text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Goodbye to all this. Agreement reached appears likely to end week-long waste crisis that has left thousands of tonnes of uncollected garbage piling up in Beirut's southern suburbs.

- Two radical Islamic clerics held a mass rally calling on the country's underprivilaged to stop paying utility bills and demanding that the government allocate half of the army's budget to Hizbollah.
- Lebanese internet market sees 60 percent growth a year.
- Lebanon and Greece sign economic accords.
- Unlicensed broadcasters refuse to shut down.
- Lebanon and Greece sign economic accords, review the Middle East peace process.
- President inaugurates Baalbek International Festival in the name of peace.
- Lebanese foreign minister begins talks in Vienna. Says "We hope for a European role in the peace process".
